subject: ADR-157: the survey designer, recorded whole -- Event Core and Humboldt, entered and exported
body: THE EVENT CORE / HUMBOLDT PAGE, WHICH EXISTS TO SAY THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN ABSENT AND NOT LOOKED FOR, WAS THE KIT'S WORST-COVERED PAGE (5 OF 14 FIELDS) AND ITS MOST-UNREAD (6 OF 6 EXPORTS). survey-design.html builds a Darwin Core Event Core deposit: a survey/site/plot/visit hierarchy, the Humboldt Extension terms that say what was searched for at every level (nothing inherited), and an occurrence table that can record ABSENCE -- the thing a flat table structurally cannot. The demo fills a field only if it is blank, so the dataset name, prefix and effort protocol are TYPED BEFORE THE EXAMPLE LOADS -- the design keeps them and every id stays as the existing assertions expect -- then an inventory type and a target taxon are added, the level dial and parent picker are driven explicitly, and ONE SITE IS BUILT BY HAND (South spring, under the survey), taking the design 15 -> 16 events. Every export is held against an oracle: Event Core 16 rows (the added site's row verbatim and comma-free), Humboldt 16 rows (its site row has no effort columns because a site is not a search, inventory type free-text, samplingEvents), occurrence 3 rows (2 present + 1 absent on visit:01), and the readme's target scope, excluded scope and namespace. THE OCCURRENCE TABLE CARRIES A RANDOM UUID PER ROW, so it is asserted on its deterministic columns only -- eventID, name, present/absent, and the absence note 'searched for within Tracheophyta and not detected' -- never on the UUID; row counts come from the oracle (15 demo + 1 = 16; occurrences unchanged because an undecided taxon is no row at all). survey-design 5 -> 14 OF 14 FIELDS, 6 unread exports -> 0 (6 emit, 6 held, 1 silent copy-ID), the kit 424 -> 433 of 520 (82% -> 83%). Eight pages entered whole. This is the second of the two pages the ADR-155 instrument fix was about, the one whose spill numbers had been noise, now driven end to end with its arithmetic pinned. 73 confirmed expectations, 0 refuted, and no page was edited -- a task-only slice. Held: the example design is deterministic so no clock freeze was needed; one export stays SILENT (a copy-ID pressed with nothing to copy), which is not unread; and the occurrence UUID is deliberately outside the oracle because asserting it would be asserting the random number generator. One test fix rode along, unrelated to the page: verify_etho read #transBox 300ms after switching to the budget pane, and under -j2 CPU contention the heavy transition-matrix render lost that race -- the pane came back empty and every transBox claim failed as a phantom regression. Per ADR-143 (a flake is a measurement of the test), the fixed settle is replaced by a wait for the panes to actually populate: a real render failure now fails at the 15s timeout, not at 300ms.
